result.result:
end

function inner_loop!(u::Vector{Point3f}, eigenstates, eigenstate_amplitudes, ki, ai, basis_functions, xyz, ku, U, i)
    state = eigenstates[i]
    amplitude = eigenstate_amplitudes[i]
    inputs = ((ki[state, 1], ki[state, 2], ki[state, 3], ai[state, 1], ai[state, 2], ai[state, 3], ku, U))
    for j in eachindex(xyz)
        b = apply_fun(basis_functions, xyz[j], inputs)
        u[j] += amplitude .* b
    end
end



function calculate_velocity_field(vf::VelocityField)
    time_step = Int(vf.ui_states.time_step)
    eigenstates = validate_eigenstate_string(vf)
    basis_functions = (vf.basis_functions["u"], vf.basis_functions["v"], vf.basis_functions["w"])
    base_flow = (vf.base_flow["u"], vf.base_flow["v"], vf.base_flow["w"])
    amplitudes = vf.amplitudes
    eigenstate_amplitudes = map(es -> amplitudes[time_step, es], eigenstates)
    ki = vf.ki
    ai = vf.ai
    xyz = vf.xyz
    ku, U = vf.ku, vf.U
    u = fill(Point3f(0, 0, 0), length(xyz))
    for i in eachindex(eigenstates)
        inner_loop!(u, eigenstates, eigenstate_amplitudes, ki, ai, basis_functions, xyz, ku, U, i)
    end

    if vf.ui_states.base_flow
        for (i, point) in enumerate(xyz)
            unew = apply_fun(base_flow, point, (0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, ku, U))
            u[i] += unew
        end
    end

    return VelocityField(
        data_dir=vf.data_dir,
        file_paths=vf.file_paths,
        xyz=vf.xyz,
        nx=vf.nx,
        ny=vf.ny,
        nz=vf.nz,
        ui_states=vf.ui_states,
        u=u,
        amplitudes=vf.amplitudes,
        time_steps=vf.time_steps,
        ki=vf.ki,
        ai=vf.ai,
        ku=vf.ku,
        U=vf.U,
        flow_type=vf.flow_type,
        basis_functions=vf.basis_functions,
        base_flow=vf.base_flow
    )
end




function apply_fun(funcs::Tuple, point, args)
    SVector{3,Float32}(
        funcs[1](point..., args...),
        funcs[2](point..., args...),
        funcs[3](point..., args...)
    )
end

function inner_loop_single_eigenstate!(
    u::Vector{SVector{3,Float32}},
    state::Int,
    amplitude,
    ki, ai,
    basis_functions,
    xyz,
    ku, U,
)
    inputs = (ki[state, 1], ki[state, 2], ki[state, 3],
        ai[state, 1], ai[state, 2], ai[state, 3], ku, U)
    for j in eachindex(xyz)
        b = apply_fun(basis_functions, xyz[j], inputs)
        u[j] += amplitude * b
    end
    return u
end
using Base.Iterators: partition
function calculate_velocity_field(vf::VelocityField)
    time_step = Int(vf.ui_states.time_step)
    eigenstates = validate_eigenstate_string(vf)
    basis_functions = (vf.basis_functions["u"], vf.basis_functions["v"], vf.basis_functions["w"])
    base_flow = (vf.base_flow["u"], vf.base_flow["v"], vf.base_flow["w"])
    amplitudes = vf.amplitudes
    eigenstate_amplitudes = map(es -> amplitudes[time_step, es], eigenstates)
    ki, ai = vf.ki, vf.ai
    xyz = SVector{3,Float32}.(vf.x, vf.y, vf.z)
    ku, U = vf.ku, vf.U

    # Partition eigenstates to distribute work evenly
    tasks_per_thread = 2
    chunk_size = max(1, length(eigenstates) ÷ (tasks_per_thread * nthreads()))
    chunks = partition(collect(eachindex(eigenstates)), chunk_size)

    # Each task computes a local partial sum and returns it
    tasks = map(chunks) do chunk
        @spawn begin
            local_u = fill(SVector{3,Float32}(0, 0, 0), length(xyz))
            for i in chunk
                state = eigenstates[i]
                amplitude = eigenstate_amplitudes[i]
                inner_loop_single_eigenstate!(local_u, state, amplitude, ki, ai, basis_functions, xyz, ku, U)
            end
            return local_u
        end
    end

    # Safely reduce results (no races)
    results = Vector{SVector{3,Float32}}[fetch(t) for t in tasks]
    u = reduce((a, b) -> a .+ b, results)

    # Add base flow if active
    if vf.ui_states.base_flow
        for (i, point) in enumerate(xyz)
            u[i] += apply_fun(base_flow, point, (0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, ku, U))
        end
    end

    ux = [v[1] for v in u]
    uy = [v[2] for v in u]
    uz = [v[3] for v in u]

    return VelocityField(
        data_dir=vf.data_dir,
        file_paths=vf.file_paths,
        x=vf.x,
        y=vf.y,
        z=vf.z,
        nx=vf.nx,
        ny=vf.ny,
        nz=vf.nz,
        ui_states=vf.ui_states,
        ux=ux,
        uy=uy,
        uz=uz,
        amplitudes=vf.amplitudes,
        time_steps=vf.time_steps,
        ki=vf.ki,
        ai=vf.ai,
        ku=vf.ku,
        U=vf.U,
        flow_type=vf.flow_type,
        basis_functions=vf.basis_functions,
        base_flow=vf.base_flow
    )
end

"""
    update_velocity_field(vf::VelocityField; ui_states=nothing, ux=nothing, uy=nothing, uz=nothing) -> VelocityField

Create a new VelocityField with optionally updated fields. Any field not provided will use the current value from the input VelocityField.

# Arguments
- `vf::VelocityField`: The original velocity field object
- `ui_states::Union{PlotSettings, Nothing}=nothing`: Optional new UI settings to use (defaults to current value)
- `ux::Union{Vector{Float64}, Nothing}=nothing`: Optional new x-component of velocity (defaults to current value)
- `uy::Union{Vector{Float64}, Nothing}=nothing`: Optional new y-component of velocity (defaults to current value)
- `uz::Union{Vector{Float64}, Nothing}=nothing`: Optional new z-component of velocity (defaults to current value)

# Returns
- `VelocityField`: A new VelocityField with updated fields
"""
function update_velocity_field(vf::VelocityField,
                              ui_states::Union{PlotSettings, Nothing}=nothing,
                              ux::Union{Vector{Float64}, Nothing}=nothing,
                              uy::Union{Vector{Float64}, Nothing}=nothing,
                              uz::Union{Vector{Float64}, Nothing}=nothing)
    # Use provided values or fall back to current values
    new_ui_states = isnothing(ui_states) ? vf.ui_states : ui_states
    new_ux = isnothing(ux) ? vf.ux : ux
    new_uy = isnothing(uy) ? vf.uy : uy
    new_uz = isnothing(uz) ? vf.uz : uz

    return VelocityField(
        data_dir = vf.data_dir,
        file_paths = vf.file_paths,
        x = vf.x,
        y = vf.y,
        z = vf.z,
        nx = vf.nx,
        ny = vf.ny,
        nz = vf.nz,
        ui_states = new_ui_states,
        ux = new_ux,
        uy = new_uy,
        uz = new_uz,
        amplitudes = vf.amplitudes,
        time_steps = vf.time_steps,
        ki = vf.ki,
        ai = vf.ai,
        ku = vf.ku,
        U = vf.U,
        flow_type = vf.flow_type,
        basis_functions = vf.basis_functions,
        base_flow = vf.base_flow
    )
end
